jobs.occupation: Steam Turbine Commissioning Engineer (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Angewandte Mechanik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

On a customer project somewhere in the world:
After the morning briefing, you will go to the site - switch on pumps, motors, etc. and start them up. Other possible steps follow: - Solving unexpected problems - Setting control parameters and performing tests - Communicating with other engineers (f/m/d). At the end of the day, you will be proud and satisfied about what you have achieved so far and know that you have brought an energy power plant one step closer to
completion.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Perform commissioning of turbines starting from single component to the full system (Turbine and auxiliaries) according to specifications and
* engineering documents, including functional tests and logic interlocks verification and reports
* Compile records to document condition of equipment and assure quality, provide required documentation and reports in accordance with the
* procedure
* Prepare and execute tests to proof operation readiness
* Independent provision of services for power plant components (gas and steam turbine generator sets, electrolysers, battery storage systems)
* worldwide
* Carry out troubleshooting, recording as well as analyzing customer problems and proposing remedial measures, which you may carry out
* yourself
* Your office is the world - and our challenges are more exciting than any traditional desk job

What You Bring

* Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering, Several years of professional experience as a Steam Turbine Commissioning Engineer is
* required
* Understanding of technical equipment and ability to work with / based on technical documentation
* Basic knowledge of general power plant technology
* Experience in power plant operations and maintenance and / or specific Siemens Steam turbine operations and maintenance know-how is a plus
* Excellent knowledge of German and English suitable for everyday use
* Strong analytical skills with an affinity to technology and innovation combined with a proactive and convincing attitude
* Team player attitude with a high level of resilience, the ability to work independently under pressure, to multitask and to focus on problem
* solving in a complex environment collaborating with international teams
* Willingness to extensively travel internationally on short notice and work flexible hours 

About the Team

Our Gas Services team offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Senior Steel Trader (all genders welcome) Global Cross Trading (Leiter/in - Export)
jobs.description:
Company

Operating on a global scale through an international sales and distribution network, tk accelis Trading, formerly thyssenkrupp Materials Trading, is your partner for long-term success. With our local contacts around the world we are represented where the customers need us. Our core capabilities embrace complex logistic services for raw and finished steel materials along with supply chain dependability and consultancy for the downstream manufacturing and metalworking industries.

Your responsibilities

Build and scale profitable physical steel trading flows, with particular emphasis on cross-border and third-country trading. Sales market focus is EMEA. We are open to candidates trading steel products, including flat products, long products, semi-finished products, or finished goods (steel derivates). More important than a specific product background is a demonstrable ability to originate repeatable, profitable international trade flows.

- Leverage in-depth commercial and technical knowledge of steel products and specifications to support profitable trading activities.
- Identify, establish, and expand sourcing opportunities and supplier relationships across global markets.
- Build, maintain, and strengthen long-term relationships with customers and suppliers on a national and international level.
- Manage the full trading cycle, including origination, pricing, negotiation, contracting, execution, receivables management, and PundL accountability.
- Develop new procurement and sales channels to drive business growth and increase market penetration.
- Collaborate effectively within a multinational environment while utilizing a strong regional and international network to expand business opportunities.
- Develop and manage a trading book to achieve agreed volume, gross margin, EBIT, working capital, and risk targets.

Your profile

- 8+ years of proven experience in physical steel trading with a strong track record of commercial success.
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, combined with a confident and professional presence.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to drive business growth while operating within corporate governance frameworks.
- Strong risk assessment capabilities to support profitable trading decisions.
- High level of integrity and thorough understanding of compliance, sanctions, competition law, and reputational risk considerations.
- Team-oriented professional with the ability to collaborate effectively in a multinational environment; prior leadership experience is an advantage.
- Based in Germany, preferably in Essen, with excellent English language skills; German is a plus.

You don’t meet all the criteria in the job advert, but would still like to join tk accelis? We’d look forward to getting to know you!

Your benefits

Here at tk accelis Trading, we are a highly globalised, diverse and dynamic team operating in a challenging yet exciting industry. We offer you the following benefits:

- A competitive compensation package with performance-related incentives
- A wide range of responsibilities within a highly motivated team, where you can shape your role as you see fit
- Excellent career prospects and professional development opportunities to help you progress within the company

We have caught your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application via the ‘Apply Now’ button!

Contact

Lars Wollherr
Sourcing und Recruiting
Tel: +49 152 01324580

We value diversity

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications, irrespective of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion and beliefs, disability, age, or sexual orientation and identity

Saarland University is a campus university with an international reputation for research excellence, particularly in computer science and in the life sciences and nanosciences. The university is also distinguished by its close ties to France and its strong European focus. Around 17,000 students, studying over one hundred different academic disciplines, are currently enrolled at Saarland University. Saarland University is officially recognized as one of Germany’s family-friendly higher-education institutions and with a combined workforce of more than 4000 it is one of the largest employers in the region.

The Chair of Energy Materials is inviting applications for the following position commencing at the earliest opportunity.

Doctoral Research Position (m/f/x)

Reference number W2917, salary in accordance with the German TV-L salary scale1, pay grade: E13 TV- L, duration of employment: 3 years, volume of employment: 50 % of standard working time.

Your task: Next-Generation Battery Materials for a Sustainable Future

You will dive into the synthesis and characterization of novel battery materials that go far beyond conventional lithium-ion systems. This interdisciplinary PhD project addresses central challenges of the energy transition, including alternative battery chemistries (e.g., sodium-ion, magnesium-based systems), solid-state electrolytes, and circular recycling strategies

Job requirements and responsibilities:

 Designing and characterizing novel electrode materials or electrolytes for post-Li technologies

 Advancing circular battery concepts (e.g., direct recycling, recovery of critical raw materials)

 Fabrication of battery electrodes (water-based binder systems, dry electrodes, free-standing)

 Structural and electrochemical characterization using state-of-the-art instrumentation, including X-ray diffraction,

Raman spectroscopy, and Scanning electron microscopy

 Active participation in the research activities of the group and collaboration with external partners

 Publish scientific papers and present results at international conferences

Your academic qualifications:

 Completed scientific university studies in Chemistry, Materials Science, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or related

fields

 Language skills (according to GER): English (C1)

The successful candidate will also be expected to:

 Hands-on experience in electrochemistry, material characterization (e.g., XRD, SEM, BET), or process engineering

is advantageous

 Strong motivation for sustainable technologies and interdisciplinary collaboration

 Independent, analytical mindset and proficiency in English

What we can offer you:

 A flexible work schedule allowing you to balance work and family, among other things the possibility of

teleworking

 Secure and future-oriented employment with attractive conditions

 A broad range of further education and professional development programmes (for example language courses)

 An occupational health management model with numerous attractive options, such as our university sports

programme

 Supplementary pension scheme (RZVK)

 Discounted tickets on local public transport services (‘Job-Ticket‘ of the saarVV)

 Job bike leasing (JobRad)

We look forward to receiving your meaningful online application (in a PDF file) by 09.11.2026 to ls-energymaterials-jobs@uni-saarland.de. Please include the reference number W2917 in the subject line of the e-mail.

If you have any questions, please contact us for assistance.

Your contact:

Herr Prof. Dr. Volker Presser

Materials Science and Engineering

Email: ls-energy-materials-jobs@uni-saarland.de

This is Worldline.

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an Accountant to join our Group Accounting team in a role at the heart of our operations. You will work closely with operational teams, monitor key topics directly linked to business performance and development, and build strong relationships with PMOs and key partners across the organization.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Working closely with the Finance department and all financial functions of the Group (Order-to-Cash teams, Business Controllers, Consolidation, Finance Management, Treasury, etc.), you will be responsible for the following tasks:

- Perform daily accounting activities: bank operations, purchases, sales, payroll, VAT, and general accounting, including analytical coding of entries.
- Process financial transactions: verification, classification, calculation, accounting and data entry.
- Prepare supplier payment runs according to deadlines (twice per month).
- Monitor and reconcile customer and supplier accounts regularly.
- Work with the FBO teams to ensure timely customer billing.
- Participate in monthly, quarterly and annual closings under IFRS and local GAAP.
- Produce regulatory reporting in accordance with local standards for tax authorities, and possibly central banks and works councils (monthly, quarterly and/or annually).
- Reconcile and justify open balance sheet items and participate in closing and balance sheet review meetings.
- Prepare and file statutory taxes: VAT, Corporate Income Tax, Environmental Taxes and other local taxes.
- Align monthly with the Consolidation team to validate intercompany positions (balance sheet and P&L) and prepare IFRS management reporting for consolidation purposes.
- Collaborate with Finance teams: Finance Business Operations, controlling, consolidation, treasury and other departments.
- Work with fiduciaries and consultants on local and international reporting.
- Manage relationships with external auditors and support internal and tax audits.
- Contribute to the design, maintenance and management of the internal control framework for existing and new activities.
- Continuously improve reporting processes and accounting controls.
- Ensure adherence to internal accounting policies.

Who Are We Looking For

We are seeking individuals capable of driving positive change—people who are proactive, passionate and ready to take initiative. In practice, this means:

- Minimum 3–4 years of experience in general accounting, either in a company or an audit firm.

Soldering operator

Working as as soldering operator at Benchmark means making solder joints, both mechanically as manually.

As a solder operator at Benchmark you are responsible for manually placing components on prints. When necessary you check, and touch-up, prints. Your experience and skills help you on a daily basis to make additional or changed connections.

Your tasks are, amongst others:

· Visually checking the PCB with the help of digital instructions and technical drawings

· Determining the process, together with manufacturing engineers, for (process) parameters for the series

· Identifying deviations from the predetermined standards

· Soldering, touch-op and outcoming goods inspection

You will work with different kind of toolings, such as: soldering iron, hot plates and/or dryers. It is a very precise job where you will be working via a microscope or dynascope.

· A salary between € 2,751 - € 3,292 gross per month based on 40 hour workweek, depending on your knowledge and experience.

· Broad development opportunities with the help of our Benchmark Academy.

· Entrepreneurship is seen, valued and encouraged.

· BeFit program: stay fit by exercising weekly with your colleagues or participating in sporting events.

· A turnover-related quarterly bonus that can amount to 5%. This percentage may vary.

· 40 vacation days during the year, when you are working on a full-time basis.

· Experience as a soldering operator or experience with a micro-soldering.

· Being able to work very precise and accurate.

· Being able to read and follow technical drawings/work instructions.

· Good knowledge of either the Dutch or English language.

Benchmark in Almelo is part of the multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., a listed company in the field of manufacturing electronics and providing services to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs).

At Benchmark you work for companies that make an impact with their innovations. We develop new products that improve safety or health or increase convenience. jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our global and diverse Gas Services (GS) organization, where putting the customer at the heart of every decision and continuously improving how we operate are the foundation of quality. Quality is more than reporting, firefighting, and correcting issues after the fact — it is about turning experience into sustainable learning and lasting improvement.
As Service Quality Professional you will act as a trusted partner and point of contact for our Regional Service Unit (RSU), driving important Service Quality initiatives and process improvements across GS. You will connect the Regional Service Units, Global Service Operations, and other stakeholders on key quality topics — sharing best practices, driving common standards, and creating transparency. Balancing global, strategic initiatives with selective, hands-on regional support, you will help ensure quality programs are successfully implemented and that sustainable improvements — measured by non-conformance costs (NCC) and customer satisfaction (NPS) — are achieved.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Act as a reliable, competent point of contact for RSU on quality topics, hurdles, and questions, ensuring RSU interests are considered in EQS decision-making.
* Enable the RSU QM community by providing the support needed to successfully implement quality programs and achieve measurable, sustainable improvements in Service Quality.
* Drive global focus-area initiatives — Customer Excellence / NPS, Service CAPA, and Process Management — in alignment with RSU needs, EQS stakeholders, and process owners.
* Support and govern prioritized improvement projects across regions, and global functions, ensuring visible, customer-felt impact.
* Foster process implementation, harmonization, and comparability of results across RSUs to reduce complexity and boost efficiency.
* Act proactively based on data — leverage dashboards, KPIs, and AI-supported insights to identify focus areas and accelerate decisions.
* Identify global, systemic issues and initiate targeted, cross-regional improvement actions, applying structured problem-solving and continuous-improvement methods.
* Facilitate best-practice sharing by highlighting regional successes and systematically addressing areas for improvement across the GS Service network.
* Provide transparency through structured reporting, and maintenance of relevant frameworks (e.g., Hoshin Kanri, Quality DoR)

What You Bring

* University degree in engineering, business, quality management, or a comparable field.
* Solid experience in quality management, process management, service operations, or continuous improvement, ideally within a complex, international, service-oriented organization.
* Understanding of quality methods and standards (e.g., ISO 9001), including non-conformance management, and their integration into daily processes.
* Experience applying continuous improvement and problem-solving methodologies (e.g., Lean Six Sigma, root-cause analysis) across multiple organizations.
* Affinity for digitalization and AI to make quality and process knowledge more accessible and processes smarter (e.g., SEPH, BIC Cloud, and related tools).
* Excellent stakeholder management, great communicator, and organizational skills, with the ability to build trust across cultures, regions, and hierarchy levels.
* Proactive, self-driven, and customer-centric mindset, balancing global strategic goals with pragmatic regional support.
* Fluency in English; further languages are a plus given the global scope of the role.

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs 

#PRO

As the leading company in the field of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 dedicated staff members. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a sustainable difference.  

**CGM Leverages AI:** We’re looking for people who feel the power of AI in the e-health environment, who want to help shape change, and who are driven by a curious passion to see how technology can make healthcare smarter, simpler, and better. 

Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference – **for a world where knowledge saves lives!** 

Are you passionate about groundbreaking products? Do you have the talent to turn ideas into real, valuable solutions—while always keeping the bigger picture in mind? Then we’d love to meet you! 

Your Impact:

- You provide professional, organizational, and people leadership for multiple software development teams and build a culture of innovation, collaboration, mentoring, and proactive ownership.
- You define and drive development strategies that focus on robust SaaS architectures and cloud technologies to maximise scalability, flexibility and time‑to‑market.
- You establish AI‑native engineering as a standard—leveraging Claude Code, agents, skills, workflows, pipelines, harnesses and context engineering—and make AI‑driven productivity gains measurable across teams
- You ensure that processes, quality, and security standards are consistently met, with rigorous attention to healthcare regulatory requirements and compliance.
- You synchronize product requirements with business-area objectives, mentor engineering leaders, and regularly communicate progress, risks, and innovations to executive management.

Your Profile:

- Extensive experience in software development leadership roles, particularly in the SaaS domain and ideally in the healthcare industry, with a strong track record of successful delivery in cloud environments.
- Excellent university degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a comparable technical field with very strong academic performance.
- Strong technical acumen in SaaS architecture, cloud and distributed systems, security, and quality automation, plus a proven track record of driving AI adoption in engineering teams, ideally including hands‑on familiarity with Claude Code or similar agentic tooling (agents, skills, workflows, pipelines, harnesses, and context engineering).
- Deep experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and Lean Management principles and the ability to scale these across multiple teams.
- Excellent English and very good German; outstanding leadership and communication skills, strong problem‑solving capabilities, high innovation drive and proactivity, and a clear alignment with our healthcare purpose and entrepreneurial mindset.

**What you can expect from us:**  

- Mobile work: Work flexibly on the move two days a week and on site three days a week. 
- **Attractive locations:** In addition to fully equipped workplaces, regular events such as summer parties and Christmas parties await you at our locations. 
- **Development:** Our in-house academy and our portfolio of external cooperation partners will support you in your further development. 
- **Health:** Health is a valuable asset for us. Our in-house canteen offers a selection of tasty and healthy dishes every day, and we welcome you to our fully equipped fitness center for weekly courses (online & offline). 
- More is always possible: The kindergarten on our CGM campus in Koblenz helps our employees to organize their working day even more flexibly. We also offer corporate benefits, the option of a job bike, a company pension scheme, and much more. 

**Diversity is part of CGM!** We look forward to receiving your application regardless of disability, gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion, age, sexual orientation, and identity. 

**Convinced?** Apply online now with your detailed application documents (including salary expectations and earliest possible starting date).

Research Associate / Project Coordinator (m/f/d)

The Department of Health Services Research at the Institute of Diversity Medicine, Faculty of Medicine, Ruhr University Bochum, Germany, is seeking to appoint a Research Associate / Project Coordinator (m/f/d) starting 1st of January 2027. The Department of Health Services Research investigates how individual diversity characteristics influence healthcare delivery and develops, implements, and evaluates innovative, patient-centred models of care. Our research focuses on the evaluation of complex interventions, participatory health services research, and the development of diversity-sensitive healthcare concepts. Our interdisciplinary work integrates health services research, public health, social sciences, and medical ethics.

The successful candidate will join the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Programme DIME – Diversity Medicine, an international initiative to establish a new joint Master's programme together with leading European and international partner universities (e.g. France, Japan, Taiwan). This position offers the unique opportunity to contribute to the development of an innovative international degree programme at the intersection of diversity medicine, global health, and higher education. As Research Associate / Project Coordinator, you will play a central role in coordinating this international consortium. You will collaborate closely with academic partners, university leadership, teaching staff, students, and funding organisations across several countries. The position requires excellent English proficiency, strong interpersonal and diplomatic skills, and outstanding organisational abilities to successfully coordinate complex international collaborations.

Scope: part-time
Duration: fixed-term, 15 Monate
Start: January 01, 2027
Apply by:  2026-09-28

Your tasks:

- Contribute to the scientific development and evaluation of the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Programme DIME - Diversity Medicine, including literature reviews and the preparation of scientific materials
- Support the collection, analysis and interpretation of data related to teaching, programme evaluation and research activities within DIME
- Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations and the dissemination of research findings
- support the coordination of academic activities within DIME, including communication with partner universities, students and visiting academics
- Assist in organising consortium meetings, workshops and selected international programme activities conducted in English
- Contribute to project documentation, reporting and the preparation of presentations and other project materials

Your profile:

- Master's degree (or equivalent university qualification) in Public Health, Health Sciences, Medicine, Health Services Research, Social Sciences, Psychology, Medical Ethics, Higher Education Management, or a related field
- Strong interest in diversity medicine, international higher education, and collaborative research
- A very good command of written and spoken English is essential, as English is the working language of the consortium and virtually all communication is conducted in English
- Excellent communication, networking, and interpersonal skills
- Outstanding diplomatic skills, intercultural competence, and confidence in working with partners from diverse academic, cultural, and professional backgrounds
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to independently manage complex international coordination processes
- Highly structured, proactive, solution-oriented, and reliable working style with a strong sense of responsibility
- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within an international team
- Experience in international project management, Erasmus+, Erasmus Mundus, university administration, or comparable international projects is desirable
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications

https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/cc8e7512da785ca30cc1b38164a505abb57cf3d50?ref=AfA (https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/cc8e7512da785ca30cc1b38164a505abb57cf3d50?ref=AfA)

Who we are

TK Elevator (TKE) is a global leader in vertical transportation and urban mobility. We provide engineering that keeps the world moving, including design, installation, and maintenance of elevators, escalators, walkways, lifts, passenger boarding bridges, stairlifts, platform lifts and home elevators – including multi-brand modernization and service any place, any time. With TK Elevator’s AI and digital solutions there are no longer any limits to urban mobility. TK Elevator became independent following its separation from the thyssenkrupp group in 2020. The company achieved sales of €9.2 billion in fiscal year 2024/2025. With around 50,000 employees, 25,000 service technicians and over 1,000 support centers globally, we are moved by what moves people. TKE – Move Beyond.

What we expect

- You will promote TK Elevator’s compliance culture and compliance awareness worldwide in close coordination with the regional compliance organization
- You will support the further development and implementation of the TK Elevator compliance strategy, with a focus on preventive measures, processes, tools, and digital solutions
- You will identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risks in the global elevator business, particularly in the area of antitrust law
- You will advise corporate functions and business units in a pragmatic, risk-oriented, and business-focused manner on compliance with applicable laws and internal guidelines
- You monitor legal and regulatory developments, assess their impact, and derive practical recommendations
- You will take on responsibility in international projects, work flexibly on changing compliance priorities, and bring an affinity for IT-supported and AI-based work methods

Who we are looking for

- You have relevant qualifications and experience in the field of compliance, ideally a law degree with in-depth knowledge of antitrust law
- You have at least 5 years of professional experience in a company, a compliance role, or a law firm specializing in commercial law
- You possess high ethical standards, sound judgment, and enjoy collaborating in a diverse, international environment
- You are characterized by strong communication skills, positive energy, flexibility, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented “can-do” attitude
- You work confidently in a matrix organization and interact successfully with various stakeholders
- You have a strong affinity for digital tools, IT-supported processes, and AI applications
- And last but not least, you are fluent in English and German

What we offer

It goes without saying, that we offer attractive conditions such as: 
Working in a successful organization with lean hierarchies and all the advantages of an international group. 
With us, you experience an exciting work environment in interdisciplinary and multinational teams. 
Very good development opportunities either in a specialist or in a management function. 
An attractive remuneration including special benefits according to the collective agreement NRW.

Contact

Please apply online in English including your salary expectation and your notice period. 
Bianca Wickinghoff
Talent Acquisition

Additional information

At TK Elevator, we aim to embrace diversity and welcome everyone -no matter the ethnicity, nationality, gender or gender expression, age, social background, religion or world belief, sexual orientation, disability, marital status or any other legally protected characteristic or status. 
Do you have a disability and would like to work with us? Then we look forward to your application! 
As a signatory of the Charter of Diversity, TK Elevator is committed to a prejudice-free and diverse working environment with equal opportunities. Although we are not completely barrier-free yet, we are working every day to improve ourselves. Let’s overcome barriers together and work on individual solutions that work for you.

Company

thyssenkrupp Forged Tech is a diversified supplier of components and system solutions for a wide range of different industries and markets. The forging group has a unique global footprint by operating around 50 forging presses and over 150 machining and assembly lines in 15 locations worldwide, including in Germany, Italy, the USA, Mexico, Brazil, India and China. With sales of well over 1 billion euro, the company specializes in the production of components and systems for the automotive, truck and construction machinery industries.

Your responsibilities

Are you passionate about driving business growth and building successful customer solutions in a global industrial environment?
At thyssenkrupp Forged Tech you will play a key role in expanding Berco’s Aftermarket business by shaping our product portfolio, supporting commercial activities and coordinating cross-functional initiatives in an international manufacturing network. Join us to contribute to profitable growth and create long-term value for our customers and business
You will

- Drive and support strategic growth initiatives for the global Aftermarket business while identifying opportunities and mitigating commercial risks.
- Coordinate Aftermarket activities across sales, operations, supply chain, finance and manufacturing sites to ensure effective business execution.
- Support commercial activities including pricing, quotations, delivery coordination and customer-related escalations.
- Optimize the Aftermarket product portfolio by supporting product introductions, standardization initiatives and profitability improvements.
- Contribute to business planning, demand forecasting and performance monitoring to support strategic decision-making.
- Collaborate with international stakeholders across the organization to drive sustainable and profitable business growth.

Your profile

You bring…

- A university degree in Business, Engineering or a comparable discipline.
- 5+ years of professional experience in Key Account Management, Sales or other commercial roles, preferably within an industrial or automotive environment.
- Strong commercial acumen and analytical skills with the ability to identify growth opportunities and drive business performance.
- Excellent communication, moderation and stakeholder management skills in an international and cross-functional environment.
- A structured and process-oriented mindset combined with a collaborative way of working.
- Fluent Business English and general willingness to travel internationally; additional Italian language skills are considered an advantage.

Your benefits

- Extensive development opportunities through global talent management and tailored qualification programs.
- Flexible work arrangements, including the option to work remotely up to 2 days per week for a better work-life balance.
- Competitive compensation package under the collective agreement of the metal and electrical industry NRW, including 30 days of vacation, additional special leave (e.g., for relocation or marriage), vacation pay, and other tarif specific payments.
- Excellent company pension scheme (“Kombipakt”) – a modern, employer-subsidized plan with attractive interest rates.
- Modern, open workspace in a central location in Essen with a healthy and varied subsidized canteen.

jobs.occupation: W3 Professorship Computational Social Science (m/f/x; Reference no.: W2906) (Sozialwissenschaftler/in)
jobs.description:
Saarland University is a campus university with a strong international focus and a distinctive research profile characterized by its four core research hubs ‘Computer Science and Informatics’, ‘BioMed’, ‘Europe’ and ‘Sustainability’. With numerous internationally respected research institutes situated in the vicinity of the university and dedicated support for start-up companies, Saarland University is an ideal environment for research, teaching and innovation. The proportion of international students studying at Saarland University is well above the national average and is testimony to the university’s strong international focus. Saarland University has been officially certified as a family-friendly university since 2004.

The Faculty of Human and Business Sciences at Saarland University is inviting applications for the following position to commence in June 2027:

W3 Professorship Computational Social Science (m/f/x; Reference no.: W2906)

The university is also inviting applications for another W2 Professorship (W3 tenure track position) in Political, Social or communication Science (m/f/x; Reference no.: W2905).

This professorial appointment is open regarding the candidate's specific research focus within the field of computational social science. The successful candidate will define their own research agenda, provided that it demonstrates excellence in computational social science, addresses current societal questions, makes use of novel digital data sources and establishes clear links with computer science.

SOUNDS is a research project at Saarland University funded through the Saarland state government’s Transformation Fund. It investigates societally relevant questions through novel digital data sources, digital behavioural traces, social media data and AI-based

methods. This professorship provides the computational social science core of the SOUNDS project. It will combine social-science theory with network analysis, automated text analysis, the study of large-scale digital behavioural data, mobile sensing and AI-based modelling, addressing questions such as collective opinion formation, social cohesion and polarisation, or the role of digital platforms in public communication, and contributing to joint questions, methods and publications with the social sciences and computer science. The successful candidate will be expected to develop and lead externally funded research, including principal investigator roles in coordinated funding initiatives such as Collaborative Research Centres. Teaching duties will include computational and methodological courses, for example on the analysis of digital behavioural data, automated text analysis and network analysis.

These courses will contribute to degree programmes in the social sciences, computer science, data science and psychology. The role also includes the supervision of student theses and the mentoring of early-career researchers. The appointment will be made in accordance with the general provisions of German public sector employment law (see legal recruitment requirements in § 41 Saarländisches Hochschulgesetz, current version available at https://recht.saarland.de/bssl/document/jlr-HSchulGSLrahmen).

We are looking for a researcher with excellent international standing in computational social science and a strong record of working with novel digital data sources applied to societally relevant questions. Your expertise should include computational methods such as network analysis, automated text analysis, the analysis of large-scale digital behavioural data and AIbased modelling. You should be open to a formal affiliation with the Department of Computer Science. You will have an established international research network, an excellent record of high-impact publication and of third-party funding, including grants secured and applications submitted. You should also be prepared to take on principal investigator roles in coordinated funding initiatives such as Collaborative Research Centres. A willingness to teach in English is expected, as is the willingness to teach in German in the medium term.

Saarland University views internationalization as a process spanning all aspects of university life. We therefore expect members of our professorial staff to promote and foster further internationalization. Special support will be provided for projects that expand collaboration within existing international cooperative networks, e.g. projects with partners in the European University Alliance Transform4Europe (www.transform4europe.eu) or the University of the Greater Region (www.uni-gr.eu).

In accordance with the objectives of its gender equality plan, Saarland University is actively seeking to increase the proportion of women in this field. Qualified women candidates are therefore strongly encouraged to apply. Preferential consideration will be given to

applications from disabled candidates of equal eligibility. Furthermore, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of nationality, ethnic heritage or social background, religious beliefs, personal beliefs or values, age, sexual orientation or identity.

Please complete the application form in Saarland University's online application portal at www.uni-saarland.de/berufungen and submit it with your application documents by no later than 15 October 2026. Application documents must be uploaded as a single PDF file (max. size 10 MB) and should include the following documents in the order specified:

- Cover letter (addressed to the Dean of the Faculty of Empirical Human Sciences and Economics),
- your résumé detailing your academic career,
- a list of your publications,
- a summary of your research activities and external funding secured to date,
- a list of courses you have taught, sample course evaluations, other evidence of your teaching qualifications,
- a two-page research plan and
- a two-page teaching plan, as well as
- your five most important publications
- Please also include proof of disability if you declared a disability in your application and,
- if you hold a university degree from a foreign university, please provide proof of equivalence from Germany's Central Office for Foreign Education (ZAB) if available. If you have not yet requested proof of equivalence from ZAB, you must submit proof at a later

date if so requested. When you submit a job application to Saarland University, you will be transmitting personal data. Please refer to our privacy notice for information on how we collect and process personal data in accordance with Art. 13 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) (www.uni-saarland.de/en/privacy). By submitting your application, you confirm that you have taken note of the information in the Saarland University privacy notice.
